tools.name: localazy_list_projects
tools.description: List the Localazy projects the token can reach (a project token reaches one project): id, slug, name, source language, your role and visibility. Optionally add owning-organization limits (keys used/available, feature flags) and per-language progress counts (active, review, current, translated, sourc

tools.name: localazy_list_import_formats
tools.description: List the file types Localazy can store strings as (type id, name, support for plurals/arrays/structured keys). The `json` type is what localazy_import_keys uses. GET /import/formats.

tools.name: localazy_list_files
tools.description: List the files in a project (id, name, type, optional path). Use a file id with localazy_get_file_keys to read its strings. GET /projects/{projectId}/files.

tools.name: localazy_get_file_keys
tools.description: Read the strings of one file in one language: key id, key path, current translation (a string, an array or a plural object keyed @one/@other). Pages of up to 1000 keys; pass `next` for the following page. Set extra_info for hidden/limit/deprecated/comment, no_content to list keys without text. Count

tools.name: localazy_list_key_links
tools.description: List links between duplicate source keys (key id, linked project id, linked key id), paged. Needs the Reviewer role. GET /projects/{projectId}/links.

tools.name: localazy_list_cdn_metadata
tools.description: List the Localazy CDN release tags of a project and the URL of each tag's metadata file (languages, plural rules). Needs the Manager role. GET /projects/{projectId}/cdn.

tools.name: localazy_get_import_progress
tools.description: Progress of an import batch started with localazy_import_keys (pass its `import_batch`). The endpoint is used by Localazy's own API client but is not in the public docs yet, so the reply is returned as Localazy sends it. GET /projects/{projectId}/import/{importBatch}.

tools.name: localazy_get_tm_suggestions
tools.description: Translation Memory suggestions for one source key into a target language: earlier translations of the same text, with the project they came from. Free; no Localazy credits. GET /projects/{projectId}/keys/{keyId}/suggestions/tm.

tools.name: localazy_get_mt_suggestions
tools.description: Machine Translation suggestions (one per engine) for one source key into a target language. Free: it does not consume Localazy credits (Localazy AI does; see localazy_translate_with_ai). The first request for a key can be slower. Nothing is saved. GET /projects/{projectId}/keys/{keyId}/suggestions/m

tools.name: localazy_list_glossary
tools.description: All glossary terms of a project: id, description, translate/case-sensitive/exact-match flags and the term in each language. GET /projects/{projectId}/glossary.

tools.name: localazy_get_glossary_term
tools.description: One glossary term by id. GET /projects/{projectId}/glossary/{id}.

tools.name: localazy_create_glossary_term
tools.description: WRITE: add one term to a project's glossary (max 1,000 terms per project). Needs the Reviewer role. The term guides translators and Localazy AI from now on. POST /projects/{projectId}/glossary.

tools.name: localazy_update_glossary_term
tools.description: WRITE: replace the content of one glossary term (the term list and any flags you pass overwrite the old values). Needs the Reviewer role. Read the term first with localazy_get_glossary_term. PUT /projects/{projectId}/glossary/{id}.

tools.name: localazy_submit_translation
tools.description: WRITE: set the translation of ONE source key in ONE target language. Reviewers, managers, owners and trusted translators set it as the current version (it overwrites the existing translation and goes live in the next download/CDN release); a translator's value is stored as a candidate for review. Va

tools.name: localazy_import_keys
tools.description: WRITE: add or update up to 50 string keys in ONE file, in ONE language (flat key -> text; use a key like "home.title" for the key name). Needs the Owner role. Nothing is deleted or deprecated, and Localazy does not overwrite existing current translations by default (translations identical to the sou

tools.name: localazy_update_key_properties
tools.description: WRITE: change a source key's translator comment, maximum translation length, or hidden flag (fields you omit stay as they are). Needs the Manager role. It does not change texts and cannot deprecate or delete the key. PUT /projects/{projectId}/keys/{keyId}.

tools.name: localazy_translate_with_ai
tools.description: COSTS CREDITS: translate up to 10 texts with Localazy AI. Every call consumes Localazy credits from the account balance, by the number of translated words (see localazy.com/pricing); nothing is stored in the project, the translations are only returned. Limits: 10 requests/minute, 32 items and 16,384

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: localazy_list_projects, localazy_get_file_keys, localazy_list_cdn_metadata, localazy_submit_translation · Private data: localazy_list_projects, localazy_list_import_formats, localazy_list_files, localazy_get_file_keys, localazy_list_cdn_metadata, localazy_import_keys · Public sink: localazy_create_glossary_term, localazy_submit_translation, localazy_import_keys, localazy_translate_with_ai · Destructive: localazy_update_glossary_term, localazy_import_keys, localazy_update_key_properties.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: localazy_list_projects, localazy_get_file_keys, localazy_list_cdn_metadata, localazy_submit_translation · Private data: localazy_list_projects, localazy_list_import_formats, localazy_list_files, localazy_get_file_keys, localazy_list_cdn_metadata, localazy_import_keys · Public sink: localazy_create_glossary_term, localazy_submit_translation, localazy_import_keys, localazy_translate_with_ai · Destructive: localazy_update_glossary_term, localazy_import_keys, localazy_update_key_properties

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
